clips.prompt: Kling first-last-frame motion with generated audio. Skip Shot 06 completely. Continue directly from Shot 05 to Shot 07 with the exact same upward-facing camera direction: no look back, no reverse angle, no viewpoint handoff, no turn-around, no visible cut, and no exterior aperture seen from inside. In Shot 05 the camera is already aimed upward toward the matte-black underside aperture and the occupied dark industrial lift. Keep that same optical axis and move straight upward with the lift into the black interior. The UFO is an absolute fixed structure in world space: it never moves, translates, descends, rises, drifts, slides, rotates, scales itself, relights, warps, or changes shape. The lift rises vertically in place through the same fixed aperture; it has no horizontal travel, no sliding, no swinging, no detaching, and no redesign. As the lift enters the vessel, the outside field is swallowed by darkness and naturally disappears below the frame; do not show the camera turning around to look back out. The surrounding space becomes the extremely tall matte-black ovoid interior with rough striated surfaces. The distant pale ceiling/contact point appears far above and grows only slightly through real vertical travel, preserving the huge scale of the vessel. The same four researchers in pale grey protective suits remain on the lift platform with black rails and compact black cases, subtly bracing; nobody walks, steps off, jumps, teleports, duplicates, floats, falls, or changes costume.
